fetch_200() {
  fetch_url=$1
  fetch_output=$2
  fetch_headers=$(/bin/busybox wget -S -O "$fetch_output" "$fetch_url" 2>&1) || {
    printf 'request failed: %s\n%s\n' "$fetch_url" "$fetch_headers" >&2
    return 1
  }
  fetch_status=$(printf '%s\n' "$fetch_headers" | /bin/busybox awk '/HTTP\// { print $2; exit }')
  if [ "$fetch_status" != 200 ]; then
    printf 'expected HTTP 200 from %s, got %s\n' "$fetch_url" "${fetch_status:-no-status}" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

unproven_effect_requirements: All writers and admission-time mutations require runtime fencing proof.
Controllers, generated Pods and Helm test hooks require closure proof.
PVCs, dynamic PV provisioning and retained database writes require storage proof.
Referenced Secrets, service accounts and namespace-local PVCs require resolution.
Mutable image tags require resolved digests before execution approval.
Service, network-policy and external database effects require runtime proof.
